text: …　なんにも　はんのう　しない

structure.jp: …　なんにも　はんのう　しない
structure.en: … it does not respond at all

patterns.name: なにも〜ない
patterns.span: なんにも　はんのう　しない
patterns.explanation: なにも together with a 'not' form means 'nothing at all'; なんにも is a stronger spoken form of it. なんにも はんのう しない = 'it doesn't respond at all'.
